explanation.whatToDo: Turn the `/** ... */` block on `SwitchOff` into a one-line `//` comment, or delete it, or export the type from `src/index.ts` if it is meant to be API.
explanation.whyHere: packages/core/AGENTS.md says: "`src/index.ts` is the package's API, and only what it exports carries TSDoc." Root AGENTS.md says: "TSDoc only on exported package API. Nothing on internals."

properties.failureScenario: `SwitchOff` is used only inside core, by guardrails.ts. It now carries a TSDoc block. A contributor who goes by the rule takes TSDoc to mean package API, so they could treat this internal type as a public contract and avoid changing it.
